checks.name: 1000 queued moves produce one geometry publication and no wire publication or routing job
Release flushes the newest position and ignores an older queued frame
One gesture has one undo entry and redo restores final geometry and routes
Identical geometry and no-op gestures do not revise, route, or add history
Incident adjacency and conservative obstacle corridors exclude distant routes
Grid-bound changes, unknown layouts and changed endpoints safely recompute
Runtime feedback survives a gesture and stays out of history and saved geometry
Replacement with the same node IDs cancels queued geometry and rejects stale gesture completion
Undo during a pending job ignores its late routes and cancels queued gesture writes
Worker failure retains final geometry and retry recovers equivalent routing
Breadboard gesture commits one topology revision; frames and derived routing add none
Locked nodes reject gestures and cancellation discards an unpainted frame
Breadboard pin connectivity changes on release and is restored by undo
Rotation and resize preserve pin identities, manual bends and one-gesture undo
